simulation_measurement_contract: Perturb a provisioned control around a demonstrated stable equilibrium, holding infrastructure and other coefficients fixed.
Measure time until a defined population or food-stock deviation halves; report overshoot and non-convergence, not just end-state population.
Keep population, food stocks and wage variables separate. This simulator does not model historical wages or endogenous fertility/marriage directly.
Compare regional uncertainty; do not force every population type or location to recover in 10-30 years.

additional_rate_evidence.exclusions: Trend estimates that combine migration and natural increase are not fertility/mortality coefficients. Frontier age structure and later chronology prevent automatic transfer to 1337 controls.

additional_rate_evidence.role: mechanism holdout: abundant land need not prevent food vulnerability; trade integration changes response
additional_rate_evidence.observation: Wheat-price/mortality checks detected before conquest, weaker subsequently. Cleared/improved estate fractions and trade matter; total potential land is insufficient.
additional_rate_evidence.exclusion: VAR price/mortality response is not a direct annual population-growth or population-recovery coefficient.

additional_rate_evidence_status: Source interpretations recorded before the next calibration round; no universal numerical acceptance envelope inferred from these geographically and temporally distinct series.
